summary: Frontend-only re-test of BahanPas AI Quick Demo Mode bug fix. All 5 requested scenarios verified end-to-end via Playwright against the public preview URL: (1) Quick Demo shows live progress banner with steps 1/6→6/6 and percentages 6%→28%→46%→64%→80%→93%→100% over ~10s, then banner disappears and button re-enables ~12s. (2) Toasts fire in sequence (start, 12 Kopi Susu Aren, 7 Vanilla Latte, susu tumpah, HPP +25%, WA draft, selesai). (3) Dashboard state actually mutates: sales=2, audit=1 (spill), Biji Kopi Arabika priceDisplay 150000→187500 (exactly 1.25x). (4) WA draft persists to state.waDraft and renders on /order via demo-wa-draft with pre-filled demo-wa-text and copy/send buttons. (5) Reset Data returns to fresh seed (5 batches, 0 sales, 0 audit, no waDraft, kopi price back to 150000). (6) Re-running Quick Demo after reset works from a fresh state with button disabled while running.

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial mount (cosmetic console warnings, no visual break).

critical_code_review_comments: AppContext.runQuickDemo uses setState(buildSeed()) then schedules setTimeouts that call recordSale/deductStock which each call setState — this relies on React state being flushed before timers fire (works because timers are 1.4s+ apart, safe here).
demoTimers cleanup effect only runs on unmount; resetDemo correctly clears timers if user resets mid-demo. Good.
Optional: expose demoStatus.step===0 initial state, or show percentage-only banner during setup — currently first render shows 6% + Langkah 0/6 which is fine but 'Langkah 0/6' is unusual copy.
test_credentials: Bypass button on /login (data-testid=bypass-login-btn); or admin@bahanpas.ai / bahanpas321
seed_data_creation: None; test cleared localStorage before run to guarantee fresh seed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quick Demo flow (AppContext.runQuickDemo + AppShell demo-progress-banner + ReorderWA demo-wa-draft) fully verified. Timers 1.4/3.2/5.0/6.8/8.6/10.2/12.2s work as designed. Biji Kopi Arabika price hike is real (1.25x). state.waDraft persists in localStorage key bahanpas_state_v1. If future tests need to clear demo state, click reset-data-btn → reset-confirm.
rca of the issue: N/A — previous bug (invisible mutations, fake HPP alert) is fixed. Verified real price hike changes state.inventory and drives Dashboard KPIs/Simulator, and waDraft persists across routes.
